title: Terrafirmask
tagline: Claim your land on our decentralized network to avoid any disputes!
description: Currently, in India, we have many land disputes among landowners, which evne leads to bloodshed. We are trying to avoid this by providing this system to the government.
how_its_made: While initially solving the problem, we realised we had many shortcomings. We later grouped up as a team and found out solutions for all of the different edge cases.
